role: Prespecified extension after inspecting the original single-block results; previously accessed surveys, not new unseen surveys
selection_rule: Center each 16-rank interval at floor((axis_length-1)*q), clipping only to valid axis bounds. Require six spatially disjoint complete blocks per survey. No amplitude-based replacement.
dictionary: Unchanged 64 finite 2D Fourier atoms: (kx/16,ky/16), kx,ky in 0..7
aggregation: Pair identical survey/block/window/H/count/seed. Average windows, H sets and seeds within each block, then give the six blocks equal weight within each survey. Report individual block effects and ranges; no survey-population significance claim.
scope: 1296 descriptive recovery cases in two previously seen poststack surveys. Spatial blocks and windows remain correlated. Nominal grid ranks, uncalibrated amplitudes; no original-SPS waveform, migration or field-cost claim.
